summary: Backend (7/7) and Frontend (all specified flows) tested end-to-end for SWIFT TASK landing page. All backend contact endpoints work correctly with proper validation. Frontend loads without errors, hero heading matches, navbar smooth-scroll (Lenis) navigates to all 4 sections, service bento cards, about-section and contact form all render. Contact form submits, shows success sonner toast, clears fields; empty submit shows validation toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is used inside POST /api/contact (line 90) but defined later at line 118. Works only because handler runs after module import completes, but it's fragile — move logging.basicConfig/logger definition above route definitions.
Contact.jsx service chip data-testid is `contact-service-<first6-lowercase>` (e.g. contact-service-infrae). Consider a stable convention like `contact-service-chip-<slug>` for easier test targeting.
CORS: allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec — browsers will reject credentialed requests. Since no auth is used it's harmless today, but should be tightened.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed contact_messages entries via API/UI for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL comes from /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Contact chip testids follow pattern `contact-service-<first 6 lowercased chars of service, spaces to '-'>` (e.g., contact-service-infrae, contact-service-softwa). Lenis smooth scroll confirmed working via window.__lenis; scrollY progresses through sections after nav clicks (1078 -> 2291 -> 3224 for servicios/nosotros/contacto).
